captions.gbp:
Meet our 3T MRI in St. Petersburg. A 3 Tesla MRI has twice the magnet strength of a standard 1.5T scanner, which gives finer detail for small structures such as the brain and pituitary, nerves, the prostate, and cartilage and ligaments in small joints. Like every MRI, it uses a magnet and radio waves, with no radiation. A 3T scanner is louder than a standard MRI, so we provide earplugs or music. If you have any implant, tell us before your scan, even if you've had an MRI before, because implant safety ratings depend on magnet strength. Self-pay 3T MRI is $295 without contrast and $395 with, the same price as our other MRIs, with the radiologist's reading included. No referral is needed for self-pay, and same-day appointments are often available. Your doctor chooses the right MRI for your exam. Visit us at 2201 Central Ave, Suite 100.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

facts_checked: No ionizing radiation; loud knocking noise needs ear protection; implants must be MR Safe/MR Conditional: FDA MRI Benefits and Risks page. MR Conditional labeling lists permitted static field strength (e.g. 1.5T or 3.0T): FDA guidance 'Testing and Labeling Medical Devices for Safety in the MR Environment'. 3T = 2x 1.5T field, finer detail for brain/prostate/small joints, louder, prices $295/$395, no referral self-pay, same-day, St. Pete address: amiweb services-data.ts 3t-mri and mri entries, pricing page.
